# freeimagecompressor.app — Full Documentation

> Free online image compressor that runs entirely in the browser.

freeimagecompressor.app is a free, browser-based image compressor that reduces JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF file sizes with no login, no uploads, and no server processing. All compression happens client-side using the Canvas API. Images never leave the user's device.

## Core Features

- **Batch compression**: Compress up to 20 images at once
- **Adjustable quality**: Slider from 1% to 100%, default 80%
- **Format conversion**: Convert between JPG, PNG, and WebP
- **Resizing**: Optional max dimension with aspect ratio preservation
- **EXIF stripping**: Metadata removed by default for privacy
- **Visual comparison**: Side-by-side, slider, and toggle comparison modes
- **ZIP download**: Download all compressed images as a single ZIP
- **Per-image quality**: Override quality for individual images
- **Dark mode**: Toggle with localStorage persistence

## How It Works

1. User drops or selects image files (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF)
2. Files are read into browser memory using FileReader
3. Images are drawn to an off-screen Canvas element
4. Canvas re-exports the image at the specified quality and format
5. Compressed blob is stored in memory for preview and download
6. Images never leave the device — zero network requests for processing

## Supported Formats

- **JPG/JPEG**: Lossy compression with quality parameter (strong effect)
- **PNG**: Lossless re-encoding (limited compression, canvas quality parameter has minimal effect)
- **WebP**: Lossy compression with quality parameter (excellent results)
- **GIF**: Converted to static image (first frame only, animation not preserved)

## Quality Guidelines

- **80%**: Recommended default for web use. 40-70% file size reduction, imperceptible quality loss.
- **60%**: Good for thumbnails and previews. 70-85% reduction.
- **90-95%**: High-quality portfolios and archival. 20-40% reduction.
- **Below 50%**: Maximum compression with visible artifacts.

## Privacy

- All processing happens in the browser via Canvas API
- Zero server uploads
- Zero analytics or tracking
- Zero cookies
- EXIF metadata (GPS, camera info, timestamps) stripped during re-encoding
- Image data never saved to localStorage
- Object URLs revoked when images are removed

## Technology

- Single HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript
- No frameworks, no build step, no backend
- Google Fonts: DM Sans (UI) and Lora (body)
- JSZip library for ZIP download functionality
- Service worker for offline support
- Responsive design with 768px mobile breakpoint

## Comparison with Other Tools

### vs TinyPNG
- **Privacy**: freeimagecompressor.app is local-only; TinyPNG uploads to servers
- **Limits**: No limits vs 20 images/month (TinyPNG free web)
- **PNG quality**: TinyPNG has better PNG compression (pngquant algorithm)
- **Features**: freeimagecompressor.app has visual comparison, adjustable quality

### vs Squoosh
- **Batch**: freeimagecompressor.app supports 20 images; Squoosh is single-image
- **Codecs**: Squoosh supports AVIF, MozJPEG, OxiPNG, WebP2
- **Simplicity**: freeimagecompressor.app has simpler UI with fewer decisions
- **Privacy**: Both are browser-based, both private
